II.
Second Peter
Richard Bauckham states that 2 Peter knew at least some of Paul’s
letters because 2 Peter 3:15 calls them “Scripture” (Bauckham, 1983, p.
147). However, he goes on to say that “there is little sign of Pauline
influence in 2 Peter” (Bauckham, 1983, p. 147).
Bauckham includes
Lindemann’s conclusion that “2 Peter is entirely uninfluenced by
Pauline theology and contains no allusion to the Pauline letters”
(Bauckham, 1983, p. 147). Bauckham gives the only allusions he sees
as even possible: 2 Peter 2:19 with Ro
